description: EOFY sale hero creative — hyperreal excavator peeling turf to reveal 'EOFY SALE ON NOW!' carved in the dirt. Low-res 1K draft for sign-off, then we go HQ + other dimensions.

frames.prompt:
Hyperreal cinematic promotional photograph, 1:1 square composition. Surreal-but-photoreal — every texture believable, lit like a paid editorial shoot.

[Context] EOFY Sale hero creative for the DiggerLid earthmoving brand. The visual metaphor: a yellow excavator's bucket peeling back a section of green grass turf like a thick living carpet, revealing rich brown earth beneath — and carved/dug into that revealed dirt is the message 'EOFY SALE ON NOW!'.

[Visual] CENTRE-FRAME HERO ACTION: a heavy steel excavator BUCKET and the lower section of the boom enter from the UPPER-RIGHT of the frame at a dramatic three-quarter angle, yellow industrial paint job on the boom (a warm earthmover yellow, distinctly different from the DiggerLid brand yellow), bright chrome hydraulic ram visible alongside. The bucket's teeth GRIP the leading edge of a thick slab of grass turf — bright living green grass on top, dense soil-and-root sub-layer underneath visible as the turf curls upward and back over the bucket like a peeled rug. The peeled turf shows its undersides — tangled white root mat, dark loam.

BELOW the peeled turf, dominating the LOWER TWO-THIRDS of the frame: rich, deep, textured dark-brown earth filling the ground plane. Scattered clods of dirt, broken chunks, small pebbles, freshly-dug clay. The earth surface CARVED with massive integrated typography reading EXACTLY 'EOFY SALE / ON NOW!' on TWO LINES — top line 'EOFY SALE' in heavy bold uppercase block-serif lettering (think dimensional carved-out letterforms), bottom line 'ON NOW!' in a flowing energetic cursive script. The letterforms are part of the earth — raised dirt-clod relief OR recessed grooves, edges crumbly with loose soil, deep shadow inside the strokes, warm raking sunlight catching the upper edges. The text reads instantly as 'made of dirt'. Zero typos, no missing characters, no extra letters.

BACKGROUND: receding ground plane with another silhouetted earthmoving machine in the distance on the right horizon, dramatic GOLDEN-HOUR SKY filling the upper third — saturated warm oranges, pinks, and amber clouds, soft volumetric haze, sun-flare glint suggested at the horizon.

FRAME BORDER: A clean THIN DiggerLid brand-yellow border (#e9de15) wrapping the ENTIRE square edge of the image — uniform thickness all four sides, roughly 1% of the frame width, sharp clean line, no fade, no gradient, the border sits on top of the image as a finished frame.

[Format] 1:1 square. 1K low-res draft for review.

[Style] Hyperreal cinematic editorial photograph, dramatic golden-hour lighting, rich earth tones, surreal-but-believable composition. Heavy hyperreal texture detail on the grass, roots, soil, and bucket. Premium production-still quality. The only text in the image is the 'EOFY SALE / ON NOW!' carved into the dirt — no other words, no captions, no logo wordmark anywhere else.
